'''Shiori Sakurai''' (Japanese: '''櫻井しおり''' ''Sakurai Shiori''), formerly known as '''Azu Sakura''' (Japanese: '''桜あず''' ''Sakura Azu''), is a Japanese voice actress for {{aniseries|PTS}}.

==Biography==
Sakurai was born on January 26, 1995 and became a voice actress as an adult, which landed her a few roles in a number of Japanese anime series, mostly with the supporting cast. She joined the {{pkmn|animated series}} during {{aniseries|SM}}, where her biggest role to date was newscaster and sports announcer {{al|Anna}}. Sakurai was formerly affiliated with the talent agency 01 Familia, before joining the talent agency Space Craft in 2019.
